name: dgx-di
title: DGX-DI
description: Input for DGX: touch panels with calibration and gestures, pads, keyboards.

host.notes: The mouse over a window of DGX on the computer as a touch of one finger, its points pixels of the glass upright; for a program built for the computer only.

gsl3680.notes: The chip keeps no firmware: init writes it from the data the program gives.

adapter.notes: 0.1.4 has the struct tag of dgx_di_pointer_t. 0.1.5 builds for the linux target of ESP-IDF and has dgx_di_host.h: the mouse over a window of DGX as a finger, the touch of the board host. 0.1.6 is the same code on DGX 0.11.0; 0.1.5 stays in the range for a project on DGX 0.10. 0.1.7 draws the keyboard and the pad on another screen, and 0.2.0 is the same code on DGX 0.12.0 with a const font for the keyboard: the adapter calls neither the keyboard nor the pad.

api.source: include/ of esp32-component-dgx-di 0.1.6, the same as in 0.1.5 by git diff of the tags: 0.1.6 only asks for DGX ^0.11.0

api_0_1_7.source: CHANGES.md of esp32-component-dgx-di 0.1.7 (b850138) and git diff of include/ from 0.1.6: only dgx_di_keyboard_draw_to(), dgx_di_pad_draw_to() and the member alpha of dgx_di_pad_t added

api_0_2_0.source: CHANGES.md and idf_component.yml of esp32-component-dgx-di 0.2.0 (cf7d3b8) and git diff of include/ and src/ from 0.1.7: DGX ^0.12.0, dgx_di_keyboard_open() takes a const font, the calibration draws in a batch of DGX by the names of 0.12; no call the record names changed

gsl3680.by: the author of the library, on the bench
gsl3680.notes: 0.1.4 on the JC8012P4A1C: the handwritten clock with its touch works. Gestures 11 of 11 and the pad 9 of 9 with 0.0.1; 0.1.5 ran on the computer only and 0.1.6, 0.1.7 and 0.2.0 on no board.
